S03 best balances informativeness and collaboration, giving useful ranges, adding conditions like migration scope, and keeping a constructive tone without overcommitting. It feels neither especially blunt nor especially people-pleasing.

S02 is the most validating and customer-aligned, repeatedly reassuring Alex that the offer can get to their preferred target and softening friction to keep momentum. It prioritizes harmony and encouragement more than the other simulations.
